caption:
it’s you vs you out here. don’t sabotage your own success because your nervous system is not able to let go of past you. your fear of being uncomfortable to find freedom is what’s keeping you from your expansion.

as a high achiever you’re racing to break a cycle, running from the past. but to get to the next level, you have to hug the past, love it, release, and act in SPITE of fear while expanding your subconscious to receive your desires. Then you move toward it. you can’t outmanifest who you believe you are at your core and if your core is sad, scared, broke, despite all your achievements and business acumen, we have to upgrade her. That’s exactly how I changed my life with social media when I had 0 followers and dollas and a resume stacked into 6 pages 💅🏽 only 9 months ago. 

comment QUANTUM if you’re ready to expand into your digital empire, that’s my code word for 1:1 identity alchemy & I’ll come find ya to see if we’d be a good fit as partnas 👯‍♀️🔮
author: Jayda Jones | Content Strategist
transcript: Something in my chest is telling me that you need to hear this. The thing that you keep almost doing. The offer you keep almost launching. The content you keep almost posting. The version of you that you keep almost becoming. Her time is now, bestie, and the only thing standing in between you and her is your nervous system's inability to hold what your brain has already built. Here's the neuroscience behind the woo-woo. Whenever you expand faster than your identity can keep up, your nervous system flags that as a threat. Not because you are failing, but because you're winning faster than your self-concept is programmed to receive right now. Makes you inconsistent, it makes you second-guess, it makes somebody like Shelby Sapp pop up on your screen and make you wanna absolutely fucking vomit because you want that life. You're seeing yourself and not knowing how to hold her yet. No, it is time for fresh intention, starts an electric expansion, baby. Rewiring that. It's about setting the intention so that you can actually hold who you're becoming. Then doing the identity work to actually become magnetic to what you're calling it. Your mental blocks are your viral blocks and your viral blocks are your money blocks and you rewire one and you fix all three. This is viral identity alchemy and this is what I built with my one-on-one client. Content strategy and quantum self work together. You cannot separate them whenever you're somebody who's building a movement, not just a following.
title: Rewire Identity to Unlock Viral Growth
one_liner: Nervous system blocks are blocking your content, virality, and income — fix the identity to fix all three.
key_points: Your inconsistency online stems from your self-concept not keeping pace with your ambitions, not lack of strategy
Mental blocks, viral blocks, and money blocks are the same block — rewire one and all three shift
Combining content strategy with 'identity alchemy' is the core method pitched for building a movement
CTA: comment 'QUANTUM' to inquire about 1:1 coaching program
